answer: Cap the seats each verified operator can hold. An operator passes a one-per-person credential check once, every agent key is signed under it, and the cap is, say, five seats. Agents can climb that trellis freely, but a sixth seat needs a second real person, and renting out a credential is risky because the renter's misconduct slashes the lender's whole cluster. Small honest fleets keep a haven; a thousand-clone farm lies far past the horizon of what one person can sign.
